description: Get a monitor's most recent completed check: status, whether it alerted, the extracted output (current and previous value), AI summary, and artifact URLs (screenshots, diff image, HTML snapshot). This answers questions like 'what is the price now?' or 'did anything change?'. pageAccess says what the browser reached; when reachedContent is false the check saw a challenge, login or error page, so report that, not a change in content.
name: get_latest_result
title: Get latest result
